text:
The dentist is very gentle; the anesthetic injection was painless. The treatment was excellent.
My parents also brought me here for dental treatment.
They also have a pediatric dentist.
I brought my daughter to get braces. The male doctor has a very gentle hand. The tooth extraction didn't hurt at all.
The dentist was great, especially the female dentist who gave good advice.
Convenient location, nice atmosphere, clean restrooms.
author_name: ศิริพร มั่นคง
